content.title: Why Schneider (SNDR) Stock Is Trading Up Today
content.summary: Shares of transportation company Schneider (NYSE:SNDR) jumped 4.5% in the afternoon session after the stock began to recover from a steep sell-off in the previous session, which was triggered by a disappointing third-quarter earnings report.

content.title: SNDR Q3 Deep Dive: Higher Claims Costs and Subdued Demand Shape Transportation Results
content.summary: Transportation company Schneider (NYSE:SNDR) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 10.4% year on year to $1.45 billion. Its GAAP profit of $0.11 per share was 45.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Schneider National (SNDR): Modest Margin Gain Reinforces Debate Over Premium Valuation and Profit Outlook
content.summary: Schneider National (SNDR) posted net profit margins of 2.3%, edging up from 2.2% a year earlier, and delivered 7.3% earnings growth over the past year. Despite this uptick, the company’s five-year record points to steeper challenges, with average annual earnings falling 14.4%. Looking ahead, revenue is expected to grow at 4.9% per year, which is below the broader US market’s pace of 10.3%. See our full analysis for Schneider National. Next up, we will see how these headline results compare...

content.title: Why Schneider (SNDR) Shares Are Falling Today
